info.name: Nuzm Platform API
info.description: Public integration surface. Set the baseUrl and apiKey collection variables.

item.name: List the AI models this organization may use

request.description: Models of ENABLED providers that have a rate card, filtered by the organization residency policy (class `customer-content`): a provider outside the allowed regions is never listed. Empty until a provider is decided, attested and enabled. Requires permission `ai:read`; the whole surface answers 404 while the `ai.enabled` flag is off.

Credits are a projection of the wallet (ledger account 2100) minus open reservations: `availableCredits = floor(wallet / creditUnitMinor) - reserved`. Usage by model and by project for the last 30 days. Requires permission `ai:read`.

Organization budget (daily credits, per-run credits/tokens, totals, alert thresholds, prompt-body logging, auto-apply) and project budgets. The ETag is the budget version (`"0"` = never set). Requires permission `ai:read`.

Needs `If-Match` (428 if absent, 412 if stale). Caps are non-negative integers or null (no cap). `logBodies=true` needs `bodyRetentionDays`. Enabling `autoApplyLowRisk` also needs `ai:write` (owner, admin, developer). Audited (`ai.budgets.updated`). Requires permission `ai:budgets:write`.
Newest first. Requires permission `ai:read`.
Body {title, projectId?}. A session holds the conversation and its runs; message bodies are stored sealed. Requires permission `ai:write`. Audited (`ai.session.created`).

item.name: List the messages of a session

request.description: Oldest first. Requires permission `ai:read`. 404 for another organization.

Body {content, attachments?: [{kind:url,url}|{kind:text,name,text}]}. The content passes the moderation hook (422 `content_blocked`, placeholder deny-list: the policy is an owner decision) and the secret scan (422 `secret_detected`) BEFORE anything is stored. Attachments are references: URLs are fetched later by the SSRF-safe fetcher inside a run, and everything enters prompts only inside delimited data blocks. Requires permission `ai:write`.
Newest first, optionally for one session or project. Requires permission `ai:read`.

Body {sessionId, kind: website|edit|chat|webapp|test-fix|mobile, projectId?, input, budget?: {maxTokens, maxCredits}}. 202 with the run and its operation. `webapp` (the 7-agent graph; `input: {brief: {prompt}, maxMinutes?, specRef?}`, needs a web-app project, served only while the org flag `app_builder.enabled` is on) and `test-fix` (bounded debugging loop) are registered by the app-builder module. `mobile` needs a project of type mobile and input {description: 3..600 characters}: the design agent returns a structured mobile spec, a human approves it (approval kind `plan`), then the Flutter project is written as a new project version. Model quality is NOT VERIFIED. A webapp run that needs a human (destructive migration, dependency outside the policy,...) waits in `waiting_approval` and is decided in the approvals inbox (`/v1/ai/approvals`; `pendingApproval.scopeHash` is the hash to quote), not through `POST /v1/ai/runs/{id}/approvals`. 402 `insufficient_credits`, 429 (too many active runs), 403 `residency_denied`, 422 `unsupported_capability` (no provider enabled), 503 `ai_unavailable` (kill switch), 409 `run_active` (one active run per session and per project). Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Requires permission `ai:write`. Audited (`ai.run.created`).
State (queued, running, waiting_approval, succeeded, failed, cancelled, budget_exceeded), step, usage and cost, the pending approval if any, artifact ids. 404 for another organization.

item.name: Get an artifact of a run

request.description: Artifact payloads (requirements, architecture, page, change_set, site_model) are immutable JSON validated against their schema.

Server-sent events `{seq,type,data,at}` with `id: <seq>`; persisted, so a dropped client resumes with `Last-Event-ID`. The stream ends when the run is finished or waits for an approval (reconnect after the decision), or after 120 s. Requires permission `ai:read`.

A queued or waiting run is cancelled at once; a running run is flagged and stops at its next step (the model call in flight is aborted and its reservation released). 409 `invalid_state` when the run is already finished. Audited (`ai.run.cancelled`).

item.name: Approve or deny a pending run approval

request.description: Body {approvalId, decision: approve|deny, note?}. Approval kinds: plan, apply_changes, publish, delete, spend, auto_apply; each is bound to the run and to the SHA-256 of the exact action and expires (24 h proposal): 409 `approval_expired`. The approver is a human member with a write role (403 otherwise); there is no AI identity in this path. Approve starts the next run segment; deny cancels the run unless the kind has its own handler. Audited (`ai.approval.granted|denied`).

The project and customer layers on top of the read-only Nuzm baseline (platform + framework), the rendered `markdown`, detected `conflicts` and `canSync` (web-app and mobile projects have a file tree). `version` 0 before the first save. Permission `builder:read`. 404 while `ai_studio.enabled` is off.

Body {projectLayer, customerLayer, customerBlock}. `If-Match: "<version>"` (0 before the first save): 428 without it, 412 when someone saved in between. A layer cannot relax a platform security rule (422 with the reasons). Every save is a new immutable version. Permission `builder:write`. Audited (`builder.instructions.updated`).
Versions newest first (at most 100). Permission `builder:read`.
Copies an old version forward as a NEW version (history is never rewritten). Permission `builder:write`. Audited.

item.name: Write CLAUDE.md into the project files

request.description: Writes `CLAUDE.md` through the safe-diff change path (a new project version and commit). `{changed:false}` when it already matches. 422 `unsupported_capability` for a website project. Permission `builder:write`.
Permission `builder:read`.

Body {skills: [slug…]} or {auto: true, industry?}; dependencies are added. Writes `.claude/skills/<slug>/` (web-app and mobile). 409 when a requested skill is blocked or when skill files were changed in the project (send `overwrite: true` to replace them). Permission `builder:write`. Audited (`builder.project_skill.installed`).
Compatibility-based: framework, language, industry, approval and scan state. Returns `install` (dependency order), `blocked` with reasons and `installed`. Permission `builder:read`.

item.name: Remove a skill from a project

request.description: Removes the skill and its files; 409 (and the skill stays installed) when its files were changed in the project unless `overwrite=true`. Permission `builder:write`. Audited.
Approved platform skills plus the organization own skills, with their current version. Permission `builder:read`.
Body {files: [{path, content}]} with a SKILL.md. Scanned; a reject finding refuses it (422); never executable; visible to this organization only. Permission `builder:write`.
Case-insensitive search over the text files of the head version: matching paths and line previews (at most 200). Edit, rename, move and delete go through `POST …/changes`. Permission `builder:read`.
`available` false when the GitHub App is not configured (production before HG-AS-01). `installUrl` carries a signed state bound to this user and organization (30 min). Permission `builder:read`.
Removes the link on the Nuzm side and unlinks every project; uninstalling the App on GitHub revokes it there. Permission `builder:write`. Audited.

Body {installationId, state}. 403 when the state is not this session (or expired); 409 when the installation belongs to another organization or GitHub is already connected. Permission `builder:write`. Audited (`builder.github.connected`).
Permission `builder:read`.

item.name: GitHub link and sync status of a project

request.description: `localChanged` / `remoteChanged` compare the project head and the branch tip with the last sync. Permission `builder:read`.

item.name: Link a project to a repository

request.description: Body {fullName}. Permission `builder:write`. Audited.

item.name: Unlink a project from its repository

request.description: Permission `builder:write`. Audited.

item.name: Import or pull the repository into the project

request.description: Body {ref?, replace?}. Files move through the safe-diff change path (secret, canary and dependency checks apply). 409 when the project has changes that are not on GitHub unless `replace: true`. Permission `builder:write`. Audited.

item.name: Push the project to a branch

request.description: Body {branch?, message?}. Commits on top of the last synced commit; never forced: 409 when the branch moved on GitHub (pull first). Permission `builder:write`. Audited.

item.name: Open pull requests of the linked repository

request.description: Permission `builder:read`.
Body {head, base?, title?, body?}. Permission `builder:write`. Audited.
Flag `ai.claude_code_sandbox` (default off); in production also the compliance approval. Nuzm never stores Claude credentials and never falls back to billable API use. Permission `builder:read`.

item.name: Start a Claude Code session in a sandbox

request.description: Body {sandboxId} (a READY sandbox of the project). Probes the unmodified `claude` binary; records only observable states (NOT_CONFIGURED, AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, ERROR); sign-in happens in the sandbox terminal. 403 `feature_disabled` while the flag is off or is open in production. Permission `sandbox:use`. Audited.
Permission `sandbox:use`. Audited.

item.name: AI Studio switches of the organization

request.description: Whether AI Studio and the Claude Code proof of concept are on for this organization, whether the app builder is on (AI Studio lives in its workspace), and whether the Claude Code compliance approval is recorded for this environment. Not behind `ai_studio.enabled`. Permission `org:read`.

item.name: Turn AI Studio or Claude Code on or off for the organization

request.description: Body {aiStudio?: boolean, claudeCode?: boolean}. Writes the organization's own feature-flag rows (no other flag can be set here). Turning Claude Code on does not lift the gate: production still refuses it until the compliance approval is recorded. Permission `org:update`. Audited with before/after (`builder.ai_studio.settings_updated`).
List API keys. Requires permission `apikey:read` in the active organization (path orgId or X-Nuzm-Org); a non-member receives 404.

item.name: Create an API key (step-up; secret shown once)

request.description: Create an API key (step-up; secret shown once). Requires permission `apikey:manage` in the active organization (path orgId or X-Nuzm-Org); a non-member receives 404. Requires a recent MFA verification (step-up).
Revoke an API key. Requires permission `apikey:manage` in the active organization (path orgId or X-Nuzm-Org); a non-member receives 404.

item.name: List the sandboxes of a project

request.description: Newest first (50). A project of another organization is 404. Permission `sandbox:use`.

item.name: Create a sandbox for a web-app project

request.description: Body {profile?: "standard", ttlMinutes?}. Starts an isolated runtime for untrusted generated code. 202 with the sandbox. Residency of the node region is evaluated first (403 `residency_denied`); 402 `budget_required` without credit; 409 `sandbox_quota_exceeded` (5 concurrent per organization); 503 `sandbox_no_capacity`; 422 `unsupported_capability` for a non-web-app project. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Permission `sandbox:use`. Audited (`sandbox.sandbox.created`). The terminal WebSocket and its ticket route need owner approval and are not exposed.
State, quotas, egress profile, runtime label and lifetime. Another organization's sandbox is 404. Permission `sandbox:use`.
Terminates the runtime (the record stays, state `terminated`). Idempotent. Permission `sandbox:use`. Audited (`sandbox.sandbox.terminated`).

item.name: Start a live preview of a web-app project

request.description: Runs the newest application spec, rendered by the trusted generator (model-authored code is not run), as a child process with an in-memory store, sample data and a demo administrator, on the isolated preview origin `<token>.<previewDomain>`. Returns the address to frame (the one-time demo session is in the URL fragment) and when the preview stops (30 minutes). A new preview replaces the project's previous one. 403 `feature_disabled` unless flag `app_builder.live_preview` is on; 404 when nothing was built yet; 429 `rate_limited` (2 per organization); 503 `service_unavailable` when previews are busy or the preview did not start; 422 `unsupported_capability` in production (needs a sandbox: HG pending). Permission `builder:write`. Audited (`builder.webapp_preview.started`)..

item.name: Stop the live preview of a web-app project

request.description: Stops the running preview of the project, if any. Idempotent. Permission `builder:write`.
Newest first. Permission `builder:read`.

item.name: Run the tests of a project version in a sandbox

request.description: Body {suite: unit|typecheck|build|e2e|all, versionId?}. 202 `queued`; the run executes in a fresh sandbox with the commands the project declares in nuzm.app.json (argv, no shell) and returns structured junit-like results; the log is redacted of secret patterns. 422 `test_suite_unavailable`. Meters `builder.build_minutes`. Permission `builder:test`.
Status, summary (suites, cases, failures), log reference and the runtime that executed it. Permission `builder:read`.
Newest first. Permission `builder:export`.

item.name: Export the source of a project version

request.description: Body {versionId?}. Source + lockfile + migrations + README + OpenAPI + SBOM as a deterministic archive with no Nuzm secret: every file is scanned first and a secret, a canary token, an unsafe path, a missing lockfile or a policy violation BLOCKS the export (422 `export_blocked`, rule and path only). Vendored third-party code needs the `export_third_party` approval (403 `approval_required`). 403 `residency_denied`. Permission `builder:export`. Audited (`builder.export.created`).
Returns a freshly signed download URL valid at most 15 minutes for a ready export (never stored; issuing it is audited as `builder.export.downloaded`). Permission `builder:export`.

Pending, decided and expired approvals across runs, deployments, exports and releases; pending ones past their 24 h expiry are marked expired first. Filters status, subjectType. Permission `ai:read`. PROPOSED ADDITION PA--02.
The exact action and the scopeHash an approver must quote. Permission `ai:read`. PROPOSED ADDITION PA--02.

Body {decision: approve|reject, scopeHash, note?}. Bound to the exact action: 409 `stale_approval_hash` for another hash, 410 `gone` after 24 h, 403 `forbidden` without the role of the approval type, 409 `conflict` for a different second decision; an identical repeat is idempotent. Permission `ai:approve` (`ai:budget` for budget increases). Audited (`ai.approval.decided`). PROPOSED ADDITION PA--02.

item.name: List audit events of the active organization

request.description: List audit events of the active organization, newest first. Requires permission `audit:read`; without `audit:read_all` (billing_admin) only billing-domain events are returned. Chain integrity is verified by a background job.
Newest first; filter status. Requires permission `automation:read`. Default OFF: 403 `feature_disabled` until the flag is on for the organization.

Body {name, definition, triggers[]}. The definition is a JSON DAG (steps http_request, nuzm_api, send_email, start_ai_run, create_deployment, delay, condition, bounded loop, transform) validated against the schema, with every expression parsed by the restricted expression language (no eval, no code), literal credentials refused, and every connector reference checked to be authorized in the organization: 422 `validation_failed` with errors[] (schema, cycle, unauthorized connector). Triggers: schedule (cron + IANA zone), webhook (the secret URL and HMAC secret are returned ONCE), platform_event (allow-listed outbox topics) and manual. The workflow starts as `draft`. Default OFF: 403 `feature_disabled` until the flag is on for the organization.

item.name: Get a workflow with its active definition and versions

request.description: Returns the active version's definition and the version list; ETag header. Another organization's workflow answers 404.

item.name: Rename, activate, pause or disable a workflow

request.description: PATCH changes `name` and `status` only (the definition changes through versions). `If-Match` is required (412 `etag_mismatch`). Activating needs a published version; an administrator pause cannot be lifted by the organization (403); a disabled workflow stays disabled.

Body {definition, notes?}. Versions are immutable (a database trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE); an identical definition returns the current version with `unchanged: true`. The new version becomes the active one; running executions keep the version they started with. 422 for an invalid definition or an unauthorized connector.

item.name: List the executions of a workflow

request.description: Newest first; filter status.

Body {versionId?, input, dedupeKey}. 202 with the execution and its durable operation (`operationId`). A repeated dedupeKey answers 200 with the ORIGINAL execution and `duplicate: true` (never a second run). 429 `rate_limited` when the plan quota or the per-minute start rate is exhausted; 409 `invalid_state` for a paused or disabled workflow. Idempotency-Key is required. Requires permission `automation:run`. Default OFF: 403 `feature_disabled` until the flag is on for the organization.

item.name: Get an execution with its steps, attempts, redacted logs and dead letters

request.description: Steps carry per-attempt status, idempotency flag, input and output (secrets removed before storage), errors; `deadLetters` lists failed steps with their replay state. Another organization's execution answers 404.
Newest first, with the authorization state (never a vault reference). Requires permission `connector:manage`.

Body {type: nuzm|http|oauth2|email, name, scopes[], rateLimit?: {perMinute, burst}, config}. Only first-party, generic HTTP, generic OAuth2 (authorization code + PKCE) and email connectors exist; named third-party connectors are out of scope. URLs in the config are checked by the SSRF policy (422 `ssrf_denied`); a body that carries a credential value is refused (422 `credential_value_rejected`). Requires permission `connector:manage`.

Body {kind: credential, vaultRef, scopes?, expiresAt?} stores a reference to a secret of THIS organization (vault://…/tenant-<orgId>-…; any other reference or a raw value is 422 `credential_value_rejected`); {kind: oauth2_start, redirectUri} returns the authorization URL with PKCE (S256) and state; {kind: oauth2_complete, state, code} exchanges the code at the tenant-supplied token endpoint through the SSRF-guarded client. Granted scopes can never exceed the connector's declared scopes (403 `connector_not_authorized`).
Newest first; secrets are never returned.

item.name: Create an outbound webhook endpoint (or rotate its secret)

request.description: Body {url, events[], description?, secretRotation?: {overlapHours}}. The URL must be https and public (422 `ssrf_denied` for private, loopback, link-local, metadata and rebinding targets). The signing secret (`whsec_…`) is shown ONCE. Deliveries carry `X-Nuzm-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hmac>` = HMAC-SHA256(secret, `<t>.<body>`) (receivers must reject timestamps older than 5 minutes and dedupe on `X-Nuzm-Event-Id`); failed deliveries retry on an exponential schedule for up to 24 hours, then are dead-lettered. Sending `secretRotation` for an existing URL rotates the secret: both secrets sign during the overlap. The delivery log read and the replay route are SCR--02 (not exposed).
Published plans with their entitlements; prices arrive with price books. Requires permission `org:read` in the active organization.
A published plan; the same catalogue for every organization. Requires permission `org:read` in the active organization.
Plan limits and features with organization overrides applied; `source` says where each value comes from. Requires permission `org:read` in the active organization.
Postings on the organization own accounts (wallet etc.) with a running balance; platform accounts are never shown. Requires permission `billing:read` in the active organization.
Prepaid wallet balance per currency (projection of the ledger). Requires permission `billing:read` in the active organization.
Monthly caps of the organization and its projects. Requires permission `billing:read`.

item.name: Create or replace a spending limit

request.description: Identified by scope (org|project) and projectId. Creating needs no precondition; replacing needs If-Match with the limit ETag (428 when missing, 412 when stale). A cap below the month spend (rated usage plus approved spend) is refused with 422 spend_approval_required. Project caps are evaluated against approved spend only until rated usage carries a project. Requires permission `billing:manage`.
Approvers (permission `billing:manage`) see every request of the organization; other callers see their own. status filters pending, approved, denied or expired. Requires permission `spend:request`.

Asks approvers to allow spend above the limit for one quote or operation. Four-eyes applies above the organization threshold (always when none is set): the requester can never decide such a request. The request expires (default 24 h). One open request per subject. Requires permission `spend:request` (developer and above).

Approve or deny a pending request. Session only, requires a recent MFA verification (step-up) and is refused while impersonating. Under four-eyes the requester cannot decide (403). 409 when already decided or expired. Requires permission `billing:manage`.
Invoicing identity of the active organization (legal name ar/en, VAT and CR numbers, address, buyer type b2b/b2c). 404 until one is set. Requires permission `billing:read`.

item.name: Create or replace the tax profile

request.description: Creating needs no precondition; replacing needs If-Match with the profile ETag (428 without, 412 when stale). Format rules (VAT/CR number, postal code, building number) are configuration marked [VERIFY] with the tax advisor; a b2b buyer needs a VAT number and a complete address. Requires permission `billing:manage`.

Issued invoices of the active organization, newest first (drafts are never stored). Filters status (open, partially_paid, paid, void, uncollectible), from and to (issue time). Requires permission `billing:read`.

Invoice with lines, tax breakdown, buyer and seller snapshots and the ZATCA status (not generated until the ZATCA module exists). An issued invoice never changes except its payment status. Requires permission `billing:read`.

The invoice as a PDF (A4), rendered from the immutable snapshot in Arabic (default, right-to-left) or English with ?lang=ar|en. Sandbox invoices carry a visible watermark. 503 when the PDF renderer is unavailable. Requires permission `billing:read`.

The stored e-invoice XML: the cleared XML of a standard (B2B) invoice, the stamped XML of a simplified one. SIMULATED environments only, not verified against ZATCA. 409 until there is one to give (e-invoicing off, not generated, not stamped, not cleared). Requires permission `billing:read`.
Credit notes of the active organization, newest first; ?invoice= filters by the original invoice. Requires permission `billing:read`.
Credit note with the credited lines and its original invoice. Requires permission `billing:read`.
Newest first; filter by status. Requires permission `billing:read`.

Body {planVersionId, paymentMethodId, quantity?}. The plan fee is read from the price book and frozen on the subscription; a plan with no flat fee configured cannot be subscribed to (422). A payment method is required (422 payment_method_required). The first charge is invoiced and paid at once (status active), or a trial starts when a trial period is configured (once per organization); if the first payment does not succeed the subscription is past_due and the plan is not assigned until it is paid. One live subscription per organization (409). Requires permission `billing:manage`.
Requires permission `billing:read`.

item.name: Preview or apply a plan, quantity or payment-method change

request.description: Body {planVersionId?, quantity?, paymentMethodId?, prorationMode?: prorate|none, preview?: boolean}. preview=true returns the proration (days left, unused credit, new charge, net) without changing anything and needs no If-Match. Applying needs If-Match with the subscription ETag (428 without, 412 when stale). prorate (default) switches now: a positive net is invoiced and paid at once, a negative net becomes a credit applied to the next renewal; none switches now with no charge or credit. A trialing subscription changes without proration. Only trialing or active subscriptions can change (409). Requires permission `billing:manage`.

item.name: Cancel at the end of the paid period

request.description: Body {reason?}. The plan stays until the current period ends, then the subscription is cancelled and the organization returns to the default plan; nothing further is invoiced. Repeating the request changes nothing. 409 when already cancelled. Requires permission `billing:manage`.
Newest first, with the last deployment. Requires permission `builder:read`.

item.name: Create a website, web-app or mobile project

request.description: Body {type: website|webapp|mobile, name, locale: [ar|en…], templateId?}. `webapp` creates the project row only: no head version, `siteModel: null`, until the first generation run; website-only surfaces (previews, forms, CMS, restoration) answer 422 `unsupported_capability` for it and `POST …/changes` is the safe-diff patch set of the web-app pipeline (`{baseVersion, patches[], message?}`). Website: Starts from one of the bilingual templates or an empty site and creates version 1 with its rendered files. 422 `quota_exceeded` beyond the project limit, 403 `residency_denied`, 409 `name_taken`. Requires permission `builder:write`. Audited (`builder.project.created`). The whole builder surface answers 404 while the `ai.enabled` flag is off. `type=mobile` creates an empty Flutter project (version 1, no files) and needs the `mobile_builder.enabled` flag (404 otherwise); site-model operations (changes, restoration) and previews refuse mobile projects with 422 `unsupported_capability`: a web preview of a Flutter app is not available yet and would never be a guarantee of device behaviour.

item.name: Get a project with its site model

request.description: The project, the site model of the head (or `versionId`), the SEO score report of that model and, with `compareTo`, the diff between two versions. The ETag is the project version (If-Match for PATCH). 404 for another organization.
Only `name` can change (locales are fixed in v1). 412 `etag_mismatch`, 428, 409 `name_taken`. Audited.

`confirmName` (query or body) must equal the project name: a human typed it, which is the approval of this destructive action. The project is soft-deleted for the retention window (30 days proposal), its previews stop working. 409 `in_use` while a deployment is in progress. Audited (`builder.project.deleted`).

item.name: List the rendered files of a version

request.description: Path, size, mime and SHA-256 of every generated file of the head (or `versionId`).
Text files as UTF-8, binary files as base64; 413 `payload_too_large` above 1 MiB.

item.name: Apply an ordered set of editor operations

request.description: Body {baseVersion, ops[], source: user, label?, assetData?}. Ops: insertComponent, updateProps, moveComponent, deleteComponent, setTokens, setText, addPage, deletePage, updatePage, setSeo, setNav, addAsset, removeAsset. Validated against the schema, applied atomically, answered with the SAFE DIFF (structural + rendered-text changes), risk flags (deletes_page, deletes_component, changes_seo, changes_slug, …), the new version and the INVERSE ops (undo). 409 `base_outdated` carries rebase info (head version, changed pages); 422 `op_invalid` lists the issues. Empty `ops` with a `label` names the current version. `source=ai` answers 403 `approval_required`: AI change sets are applied only through a run approval. Single writer per project (row lock, ETag). Audited (`builder.change.applied`).
Newest first; history is immutable. `isHead` marks the current head.
Creates a NEW head version from the chosen one; history is never rewritten. 409 `conflict` when the version already is the head. Audited (`builder.version.restored`).
Ids, versions and expiry; never a usable URL.

Body {viewport?: mobile|tablet|desktop, versionId?}. Returns an unguessable URL (160-bit token in the host name) on the ISOLATED preview origin, a different registrable domain from the console and the API, expiring (30 min proposal). The token is shown only here. 429 beyond the active-preview limit.
Forms of the project (those of the site model are registered automatically) with submission and blocked-spam counts and the public endpoint.
Body {formKey, name, fields: [{name, type: text|email|tel|textarea, required?}], notifyEmail?, retentionDays?}. The notification address is stored sealed. 409 `name_taken`.
Class `personal`, stored sealed. Roles without `builder:submissions:read` (viewer) get every value masked; unmasked reads are audited.
Typed collections with their items and publish state.

item.name: Create a collection and/or add items

request.description: Body {collectionKey, name?, fields?, items?: [{data, state?: draft|published}]}. A new collection needs name and fields (text, number, boolean, date, localized_text); items are validated against them. Only PUBLISHED items are consumed by a build (sections with `props.collection`).

The published templates of the platform library and the organization's own (S-K7): metadata, compatibility facts, the reuse the permissions allow, the licence, a safe design summary and capability names. Never file contents, paths or object keys. Text search is over the published metadata, Arabic or English. Requires `builder:read`. 404 while the flag `knowledge.customer_templates` is off.
A published template. A resource that is not active, published, licence-eligible and reuse-permitted is 404, indistinguishable from a missing one. Requires `builder:read`.

The recommendation engine (S-K5) answered for a customer: hard filters first, then the weighted model over eligible templates only, then the strategy. A user's choice is honoured or explained, never substituted; an unusable choice that the customer may not see is reported as not found. Nothing is returned about resources the customer may not see (no exclusion list, no document text, no paths). Records the customer's own usage events for the top results. Requires `builder:read`.

item.name: Start a project from a template

request.description: Copies the pinned, immutable version of a published template into a NEW web-app project of the organization through the safe-change pipeline (path, secret and canary checks, size limits, dependency policy, one Git commit). The template is never modified. Eligibility is re-checked for the adaptation mode (default ADAPTIVE) at copy time: an unusable template answers `knowledge_template_incompatible` (409) with the reasons, a changed template 409. Binary and unstored files are not copied and are listed. Records the customer's usage events, a link from the project to the pinned version, and the audit event `knowledge.template.copied`. Requires `builder:write`; needs `app_builder.enabled` and `knowledge.customer_templates`.

Records the requirement and the deterministic template selection for a project of the organization. Executing the plan (generation) is the run engine with a model (S-K6) and is reported as blocked in the plan. Requires `builder:write`; audited (`knowledge.plan.created`).
A plan of this organization (another organization's plan is a 404). Requires `builder:read`.

item.name: A project compared with its template copy

item.name: What a model would receive for a plan

request.description: The bounded, ordered context assembled for a plan from the CURRENT state of the project: the platform policy for the adaptation mode (trusted), then the requirement, template facts, the file index and file contents by priority, each as a data block. Shows what was left out and why. Source of a template is sent only when the template's AI-processing permission allows it: contents of files that are still the template's are withheld otherwise (paths and sizes only); the customer's own work is always eligible. Nothing is sent anywhere by this call. Requires `builder:read`; 404 while `knowledge.generation` is off.

item.name: Read-only execution timeline of a plan run

request.description: What the run of a plan did, step by step (S-AG3): the model turns (phase, tokens), the read-only tool calls of each (tool, redacted arguments, outcome, result size), the validation and apply steps, a fallback to the single-call adaptation and why, the limits used against their ceilings, and the outcome. Only the customer's own run data; nothing is written, no model is called, no file content is returned. A plan without a run answers mode NONE; a single-call run answers SINGLE_CALL. Requires `builder:read`; 404 while `knowledge.generation` is off.

Without it: ONE structured model call over the assembled context (metered, residency-checked, budget-capped, output secret-scanned, repair loop), then the proposed change set passes the same safety checks as every change and is committed on the AI branch `work/ai`, never on the main branch. Not the coding agent: no tool use, no on-demand file fetch, nothing is executed. A plan starts once (409 otherwise). Requires `ai:write`, `app_builder.enabled` and `knowledge.generation`; audited. Model quality is NOT VERIFIED.

item.name: Create a compute instance from a quote

request.description: Consumes the compute quote, records a cost-authorization hold for the first period, re-evaluates eligibility, residency, capability, quota and price at execution (TOCTOU) and starts a durable operation (202). Errors: 409 quote_expired|quote_consumed|price_changed, 422 spend_approval_required (with approvalId), 403 residency_denied, 422 quota_exceeded|unsupported_capability|no_eligible_offer. Requires permission `compute:instance:create` and an Idempotency-Key.

Async (202 + operationId). Requires If-Match; 409 deletion_protected while protection is on; an instance whose state is uncertain is reconciled BEFORE the delete. Requires permission `compute:instance:delete`.

item.name: Start, stop, reboot, resize or snapshot an instance

request.description: Body {type, params}. Only types in the instance capability set are accepted, otherwise 422 unsupported_capability (never a silent no-op); 409 invalid_state; idempotent per Idempotency-Key. resize takes params.offerId of an eligible plan in the same placement. Requires permission `compute:instance:act`.
Series for a window (default the last hour, at most 7 days). 422 unsupported_capability when the provider exposes no metrics. Requires permission `compute:instance:read`.

item.name: Create a quote (one endpoint for every kind)

request.description: Priced by the pricer registered for the kind from the price book version effective now. The quote carries a provisional tax estimate, a not_evaluated residency block, and requiresApproval when the monthly spend cap would be exceeded. It is immutable once issued and valid until expiresAt (default 15 minutes). A hard quota the quote would exceed refuses it (quota_exceeded). Requires permission `quote:create`.
status is issued, or expired once expiresAt has passed (the stored quote never changes). Requires permission `quote:read` (owner, admin, billing_admin, developer).

The CURRENT consent per (subject, purpose), newest first; history=true returns every row. Filters purposeId, subject, status (granted|withdrawn: the current state). A caller without `privacy:consent:manage` sees only their own subject (403 when asking for another). Requires permission `privacy:consent:self`.

Body {purposeId, granted: true, localeShown: ar|en, textVersion, subjectRef?}. APPEND-ONLY history: the grant is a new row. textVersion must be the CURRENT wording of the purpose (422 otherwise: show the current text first); an unknown purpose is 409 consent_purpose_unknown. Without subjectRef the subject is the caller (any member); subjectRef (an opaque id, never an email or name; "org" for the organization itself) needs `privacy:consent:manage` (owner, admin), else 403. Granting again with the same wording while already granted answers 200 with the existing record and writes nothing; 201 when a row was written. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Requires permission `privacy:consent:self`. Audited. The purposes and their wording come from spec/compliance/purposes.yaml; the wording is a COUNSEL-TEXT-REQUIRED placeholder until.

Records a `withdrawn` entry for the subject and purpose of the named record (the row is retained). Applies immediately: the next check sees it. Withdrawing something already withdrawn changes nothing. 404 for an unknown id, for another organization's, and for a member asking about someone else's record. Requires permission `privacy:consent:self` (acting for another subject needs `privacy:consent:manage`). Audited.

Newest first. Filters status, type, subject. A caller without `privacy:dsr:manage` sees only the requests about themselves. Each item carries slaState (ok, warning from 70% of the time, escalated from 90%, overdue) and its tasks. Requires permission `privacy:dsr:self`.

Body {type: access|correction|deletion|portability, subjectRef?, details?: {text?, patch?}, identityAttestation?}. Without subjectRef the subject is the caller (verified by their session). A request about someone else (an end user of the organization) needs `privacy:dsr:manage` (owner, admin) and identityAttestation, how the identity was checked (10..500 characters), else 422 dsr_identity_unverified. A correction needs details.patch. Free-text details are SEALED (field encryption) and never returned (hasDetails only). 201 received with dueAt and operationId; the request then runs as an operation: handlers export, rectify or erase per module, never bypassing a legal hold (legal_hold_active) or mandatory retention (retention_mandatory): those are refused with a recorded reason and the request is partially_fulfilled or rejected. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key (a replay returns the same request). Requires permission `privacy:dsr:self`. Audited.

The request with its tasks (handler, action, status, reasonCode with Arabic and English wording), outcome and reason. For an access or portability request that finished, downloadUrl is a signed, expiring link: `?download=<token>` returns the encrypted-at-rest archive (application/gzip) of THIS request only (a token from another request is 404; 410 when the link or the archive expired), so a member can fetch their own data without the export permission. 404 for an unknown id, for another organization and for a member asking about someone else. Requires permission `privacy:dsr:self`.

item.name: List data exports or download one

request.description: The exports (status, expiry, size, sha256, a signed downloadUrl while ready). With ?download=<token> returns the archive (application/gzip) of that link; 410 when the link or the archive has expired; the token is sealed and bound to the organization (a token of another organization is 404). Requires permission `privacy:export:manage`.

Body {scope: org|user, subjectRef?}. Asynchronous (an operation): 202 with the export pending; 200 on an Idempotency-Key replay. The archive is encrypted at rest in the export sink and downloaded through a signed, expiring link (archive 72 h, link 15 min by default). 422 no_export_sink when the deployment has no sink; 422 quota_exceeded past 5 exports in progress. Requires permission `privacy:export:manage` (owner, admin). Audited.

item.name: Get the organization's data residency policy

request.description: The effective policy: version 0 and isDefault true when the organization has set none (the default is in-Kingdom only), plus the platform FLOOR per data class. Returns an ETag. Requires permission `privacy:residency:read` (every role).

item.name: Set the organization's data residency policy (tighten only)

request.description: Body {mode: in_kingdom_only|allow_listed|unrestricted_with_assessment, allowedCountriesByClass, exceptions (ids of approved transfer assessments), changeNote?}. Versions are immutable; the first policy needs no precondition, a replacement needs If-Match (428 without, 412 when stale). The engine always applies the STRICTER of the mode and the platform floor of each class, and an organization may only tighten the floor: countries for a class the floor keeps in the Kingdom, or an assessment for such a class, are 422 policy_below_floor. Every exception must be an approved assessment that applies to this organization (an expired one is 422 assessment_expired). Requires permission `privacy:residency:manage` (owner, admin). Audited.
Newest first; filters engine and status. Deleted databases are not listed. Requires permission `data:db:read`.

item.name: Create a managed database or Redis instance

request.description: Body {quoteId (a quote of kind `database`), engine: postgresql|mysql|redis, version, name, network?: {access: private|allowlist, allowCidrs?}, backupPolicy?}. 202 with status `provisioning` and `operationId`: the order is placed from the quote, the offer is re-derived NOW (enabled provider, available plan, verified region, supported version) and residency is evaluated (403 `residency_denied`). 422 `unsupported_capability` when no provider is enabled for the engine or the probe does not report it supported (nothing is ever mocked in production). 409 when the name is taken or the quote was used. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key; the provider call carries a deterministic token and an uncertain outcome is reconciled before any retry. The response carries a vault REFERENCE only, never a secret. Requires permission `data:db:write`. Audited.

State, endpoint {host, port}, `tlsRequired` (always true), network posture, `dataRegion`, `providerRegionId`, the vault REFERENCE of the connection secret (never the secret), backup policy, rotation window and the ETag. The provider and its account are never shown to customers. 404 for another organization. Requires permission `data:db:read`.

Body {name?, backupPolicy?: {enabled?, retentionDays?, intervalHours?}, plan?}. Requires If-Match (428/412). `name` needs `data:db:write`; `backupPolicy` and `plan` need `data:db:admin`; the policy is bounded by the organization entitlements. `plan` (resize) answers 422 `unsupported_capability` unless the provider probe reports resize as supported: the action is disabled, never a silent no-op.

The typed database name must be sent as `confirmName` (query or JSON body), else 422. 409 `in_use` while a site or app is bound to it (DatabaseBindingPort). 202 + operation: a final backup is taken per the backup policy (a failed final backup STOPS the deletion), then the instance is destroyed and its vault entry removed. Requires permission `data:db:admin`. Audited.

item.name: List backups with their restores and verification history

request.description: Newest first. Each backup lists the restores (and verification drills) made from it and the last verification result, which is how the console shows verification history. Requires permission `data:db:read`.

Body {type?: manual}. 202 + operation; the backup is stored in a system bucket of the database's own data region and carries size, SHA-256 checksum and a manifest of sampled tables. 409 unless the database is running; 422 `unsupported_capability` when the provider cannot back it up (never faked). Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Requires permission `data:db:write`.

item.name: Restore a database from a backup

request.description: Body {backupId, target?: new|inplace (default new), name?, confirmInPlace?, confirmName?, region?}. DEFAULT is restore-to-NEW in the same organization and provider region. `target=inplace` needs `confirmInPlace=true`, `confirmName` equal to the database name and a recent MFA verification (401 `step_up_required`), takes an automatic pre-restore backup first and answers 422 `restore_not_supported` when the provider cannot restore in place. A body that names another organization is 403; another organization's backup is 404; a region other than the source is checked against residency (403 `residency_denied`) and otherwise 422 `restore_not_supported`. The restored data is verified against the backup manifest: a mismatch fails the restore and raises an alert. 202 + operation. Requires permission `data:db:admin`. Audited.

Body {role?}. 202 + operation. The NEW credential is issued while the old one keeps working, its secret goes to the vault, consumers are notified through DatabaseBindingPort and switch inside the window (proposal 24 h); at the window end the old credential is revoked. 409 `rotation_in_progress` while a rotation is pending or its window is open; 422 `unsupported_capability` when the provider has no dual-credential support (the action is disabled). Needs a recent MFA verification. The secret is never returned: the one-time reveal is (not exposed until approved). Requires permission `data:db:admin`. Audited.
Newest first. Requires permission `data:storage:read`.

Body {name, quoteId (a quote of kind `storage`), region?, versioning?}. The bucket is named `nz-<orgShort>-<name>` (the namespace comes from the organization, never from input), PRIVATE by default (`public`, `policy` or an organization cannot be set here) and gets its own bucket-scoped credential stored in the vault. 202 + operation. 409 `name_taken` (the same answer whoever holds the name: names of other organizations cannot be enumerated); 422 `unsupported_capability` when no object-storage provider is enabled or the probe does not report buckets supported; 422 `quota_exceeded` beyond the entitlement bucket count; 403 `residency_denied`. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Requires permission `data:storage:write`. Audited.

State, endpoint, `dataRegion`, `public`, versioning, quota, lifecycle, last usage (with which figures the provider could report), the vault REFERENCE of the bucket credential (never the secret) and the ETag. 404 for another organization, identical to a bucket that does not exist. Requires permission `data:storage:read`.
Body {quotaBytes}. Requires If-Match (428/412); bounded by the entitlement. Requires permission `data:storage:admin`.

`confirmName` (query or JSON body) must equal the bucket name. An EMPTY bucket only (409 otherwise); `force=true` deletes the objects too and needs `data:storage:admin` plus a recent MFA verification. 202 + operation. Requires permission `data:storage:write`. Audited.
The policy document (deny-by-default subset) and its ETag. Requires permission `data:storage:read`.

Body {policy: {version: 1, access: private|public-read, statements: [{effect: allow, actions, prefix, principal: bucket-credentials}], cors?}, confirmPublic?} (the policy may also be the body itself). Requires If-Match with the policy ETag. Only the documented subset is accepted: anything else is 422 `policy_invalid`. `access=public-read` needs `confirmPublic=true` (else 422 `policy_invalid`), a recent MFA verification, and is audited (`data.bucket.made_public`); the console shows a warning. Requires permission `data:storage:admin`.

Body {key, method: GET|HEAD|PUT|DELETE, ttlSeconds?}. Method-scoped: GET and HEAD need `data:storage:read`, PUT and DELETE also need `data:storage:write`. Default TTL 900 s, maximum 604800 s (7 days): 422 `ttl_too_long`. The URL is returned once and is never logged; the audit event carries a hash of the key. 422 `unsupported_capability` when the provider cannot sign. Requires permission `data:storage:read`.
The rules and which actions the provider supports (expiry, multipart abort, transitions): unsupported actions are hidden by the console. Requires permission `data:storage:read`.

Body {rules: [{id, prefix, expireDays?, abortIncompleteMultipartDays?, transition?}]}. Expiry and multipart-abort need their capability; transitions only if the probe says so: otherwise 422 `unsupported_capability` (never a silent no-op). Requires permission `data:storage:write`.
Newest first.

item.name: Publish a project to a hosting site

request.description: WEB-APP projects are dispatched to the app-builder pipeline: body {projectId, versionId?, target: {type: site, id}, env: production|staging}; a production target needs hash-bound approvals decided in the approvals inbox (403 `approval_required` with `approvals[{id,type,scopeHash}]`, then repeat the same request), the build runs in a sandbox, only the static `public/` front end is published through the hosting publish port (the Node back end and the database migrations have no compute path yet: NOT VERIFIED live), a failed health gate restores the previous release; a `site` target is a hosting site of the organization (404 otherwise; `instance` targets have no publish path). Needs a human PUBLISH approval bound to the exact version, target and environment: the first call answers 403 `approval_required` with `approvalId` and the cost disclosure; repeat with that `approvalId` and a NEW Idempotency-Key to confirm. Then build → stage → smoke (HTTP 200 on every page, TLS) → switch → live smoke; a failed smoke check rolls back automatically. 404 for another organization site, 409 (one deployment in flight per target), 422 `unsupported_capability`. Audited (`deploy.deployment.*`).
State (queued, building, deploying, smoke_checking, succeeded, failed, rolled_back), artifact hash, smoke results, URL, error.
Append-only log lines `{seq, level, message, data, at}`.

Query q (a label or a full name; IDN is converted to punycode), tlds (comma list, default: every TLD that policy and a verified registrar allow), country. Only verified registrar capabilities are used; a TLD outside the policy is listed as blocked without a vendor call. Cached: availability 60 s, catalogue 15 min (proposals). Filters state, q (substring of the name), limit, cursor. Requires domain:read.

item.name: Order a domain from a quote

request.description: Body {quoteId, contacts:{registrant, admin?, tech?, billing?}, nameservers?, autoRenew?, privacy?}. The quote (kind domain, ONE register item) must be valid (409 quote_expired), eligible, and covered by the spend cap or an approved spend approval (403 approval_required); the wallet must cover it (402 payment_required: nothing is reserved). Funds are reserved in the ledger, the registrar is called through a platform operation with a deterministic token, the order is confirmed (ledger record, meter event) only after the registrar did. Registrant contacts are personal data: sealed at rest, residency-checked before they leave (403 residency_denied), and without privacy protection the consent domain_registrant_disclosure is required (422 consent_required). A taken name is 409 domain_unavailable. Answers 202 with operationId and the pending domain. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key and per quote. Requires domain:write. Audited.

Body {name, quoteId (action transfer_in), authCode (write-only) or authCodeRef (vault://), contacts, nameservers?, privacy?}. The auth code goes to the vault and only its reference is kept; it is never returned, logged or audited. 422 transfer_locked when the registrar reports the domain locked. item.name: Change contacts, nameservers, lock or auto-renew

request.description: Body any of {contacts, nameservers, lock, autoRenew}; If-Match required. Fields the registrar cannot change are 422 unsupported_capability (never a silent no-op). Contacts are residency- and consent-checked. autoRenew is the PLATFORM's renewal flag (the vendor's own auto-renew stays off). 200 when applied, 202 with operationId when the registrar did not answer in time (reconciled). Requires domain:write. Audited.

Body {quoteId (action renew), years}. Funds are reserved first (402), the spend cap applies (403 approval_required). A replayed run never extends the registration twice. 202 with operationId. Requires domain:renew (owner, admin, billing_admin). Idempotent. Audited.

item.name: Latest eligibility evaluation of a domain

request.description: The last stored evaluation {rule,state,reason,ruleSetVersion,evidence}. Requires domain:read.

item.name: Platform-managed DNS records of a domain

request.description: ADDITION-2 (approved by the owner). The records written by the platform (hosting linkage, certificate challenges) in the domain's zone. Requires domain:read.

item.name: Preview or apply the DNS records that link a domain to a hosting site

request.description: ADDITION-2. Body {siteId, apply?}. Without apply the response is a PREVIEW {outcome:preview, proposal:{records, changes, replaces, ssl}} built from the site's real targets. With apply:true the records are written through the atomic DNS change-set as platform-managed (linkage) records and the approver is audited; applying again is {outcome:unchanged}. Requires domain:write and a DNS zone for the domain.
Requires dns:read.

item.name: Create a DNS zone for a domain

request.description: Body {domainId}. DNS is hosted by the domain's registrar adapter only: without a supported dns capability the zone cannot be created. Requires dns:write. Idempotent. Audited.
ETag = zone version. Requires dns:read.
Filters name, type. ETag = zone version. Requires dns:read.

Body {create[], update[], delete[]}; If-Match (zone version) required. The whole set is validated first (422 record_invalid with errors[]: type rules, no CNAME at the apex or beside other records, TTL 60..86400, TXT chunking, SRV/MX/CAA fields, IDN, duplicates, quota). Then applied through the registrar's DNS adapter; when the adapter is not atomic the platform snapshots, applies, verifies by re-reading and rolls back on mismatch (zone marked degraded when the rollback is uncertain). Response: per-change results and the new ETag. 412 etag_mismatch. _acme-challenge and records pointing at Nuzm hosting are writable only through DnsLinkagePort. Requires dns:write. Audited (dns.changeset.applied|rolled_back).
Newest first, with the required records and their last checked status (ok, missing, conflict, unknown). Requires permission `email:read`.

Body {domain, purposes: [mailbox|transactional]}. 201 with the REQUIRED DNS records, declared by the enabled provider adapters (ownership, ONE merged SPF, DKIM selectors, MX for mailboxes, return-path) plus Nuzm's own ownership TXT (a token bound to this organization) and DMARC guidance (start `p=none`); state `pending`. 422 `unsupported_capability` when no provider is enabled for a purpose; 403 `residency_denied` when the provider's processing region is not allowed for personal data; 422 `domain_not_owned` when another account already VERIFIED the domain; 409 when this organization already added it. Requires permission `email:domain:manage`. Audited.

Body {apply?: boolean}. Looks every record up on SEVERAL resolvers (a majority decides; duplicate SPF, a wrong DKIM target or a foreign MX is a conflict), then asks the provider whether it verified the domain: `verified` needs both. `apply=true` writes the records through the DNS zone (managed_by `email-verification`) when the domain is a Nuzm zone, else 422 `unsupported_capability` and the console shows manual instructions. If every resolver fails the state is unchanged and the retry comes sooner; otherwise the next automatic check follows the smallest TTL seen. Requires permission `email:domain:manage`.
Newest first; filter domainId. Requires permission `email:read`.

Body {domainId, localPart, quotaMb, quoteId (a quote of kind `email`)}. The domain must be verified for the mailbox purpose. 202 + operation. The password is set through the provider's reset link or a one-time secret that goes straight into the vault: the response and every other endpoint show only its KIND (`passwordSetup`). 409 address taken, 422 `unsupported_capability` / `quota_exceeded`, 403 `residency_denied`. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Requires permission `email:mailbox:manage`. Audited.
Body {quotaMb}. Requires If-Match. 202 + operation; 422 `unsupported_capability` when the provider cannot change quotas. Requires permission `email:mailbox:manage`.
202 + operation; the provider mailbox is deleted and its vault entry removed. Requires permission `email:mailbox:manage`. Audited.
Newest first. Requires permission `email:read`.
Body {mailboxId, localPart}. 202 + operation; 409 when the address is already an alias or a mailbox. Requires permission `email:mailbox:manage`.
Newest first. Requires permission `email:read`.

Body {domainId, fromAddress}: a plain address of a domain this organization added for transactional email. `pending` until the domain verifies, then `verified`. Anti-spoofing: only a verified identity of the organization can be a sender. Requires permission `email:domain:manage`.
Newest first; filter key. Requires permission `email:read`.

item.name: Create a template or a new version

request.description: Body {key, name, locale: ar|en, subject, html, text?, variables?: {name: {type: string|number, required}}}. A new key is version 1; an existing key gets the NEXT version (versions are immutable). The HTML is sanitized with an allow-list (no script, handlers, styles or script URLs), every placeholder must be declared, the subject cannot contain line breaks, Arabic templates are RTL. Requires permission `email:template:write`.
Newest first; filters status, senderId. Metadata only: never recipients or content. Requires permission `email:read`.

Body {senderId, to[], templateId+variables | subject+html(+text), category: transactional}. Idempotency-Key is MANDATORY. 202 {id, status: queued}. Only `category=transactional` is accepted (422 `category_not_allowed`; marketing and bulk are blocked, as are more than 10 recipients); 422 `sender_not_verified`; 422 `suppressed` when any recipient is on the suppression list; 429 `rate_limited` (per-minute rate, warm-up allowance, auto-throttle at bounce rate above 5% or complaint rate above 0.1% over 24 h; proposals); 403 `residency_denied`; header injection and unsafe HTML are rejected or neutralized. The send is a durable operation: a replay is one provider call; the usage meter is emitted when the provider ACCEPTED the message, not when it was queued. Content is stored as a hash (sealed only for the queue buffer, or N days when the organization enabled retention); recipients are sealed. Requires permission `email:send`.

item.name: Get a message with its event timeline

request.description: Status, counts, provider-acceptance time and the event timeline (sent, delivered, bounce, complaint,...). 404 for another organization. Requires permission `email:read`.
Newest first; filters type, messageId. Events are append-only and carry no addresses or content. Requires permission `email:read`.
Newest first; filter active. Addresses are shown to the organization's own readers (sealed at rest). Requires permission `email:read`.

Body {address, action?: add|remove, override?}. Add (default) is a manual suppression, idempotent. Remove is audited; removing a hard bounce or a complaint needs `override=true`. Hard bounces and complaints are also added AUTOMATICALLY from provider webhooks. Requires permission `email:domain:manage`.

Connections of the organization with their email domains and DNS TXT proof status (txtName/txtValue while pending), JIT policy, enforcement flag and the signing-certificate count (never the certificates or any secret). Requires org:security. Feature flag enterprise.sso.

item.name: Create or update an SSO connection
